_rule: Only change passes/evidence after a customer walk on a real box. Never edit or remove a journey's steps; scope changes need kien and SHIP.md.

journeys.title: Clean install from a signed release, sign in, turn on two-step
steps: install.sh from a signed release on a clean box
first-run setup and admin sign-in
turn on two-step and sign in again

journeys.title: Scan the LAN, see devices with vendor and version
steps: plug the box into the LAN
within 1 hour Devices lists the LAN
firewall, router, printer, servers show vendor and, where exposed, version

journeys.title: A new KEV matching a device raises a finding and an alert within 1 hour
steps: a KEV entry matches a device
a finding appears
the alert reaches Email or Telegram within 1 hour

journeys.title: Open a finding: patch guidance and firewall mitigation config
steps: open the finding
see the fixed version and link
see a ready mitigation config for the firewall in use
see how to check whether it was already exploited
journeys.evidence: FAIL on n74, 2026-11-17 (AI-Mlee as qa-walker, browser). Steps 1-2 pass: WINLAB01 CVE-2025-59287 shows 'Fixed in 10.0.26100.6905: upgrade from 10.0.26100.1742' and the MSRC advisory link. Steps 3-4 fail on every finding: no confirmed mitigation pack ships (content/mitigation/packs has only README), so no firewall config section and 'Have I been hit?' says 'No confirmed exploitation signs'. Ask my AI on Juniper CVE-2023-36845 gave prose and steps, no config for the firewall in use. sessions/customer-walk-n74.md M2-1..M2-6.

journeys.title: Plan page says what to update
steps: open Updates to plan
each item names the update, the device and the CVEs it fixes
likely-exploited first

journeys.title: Public IP: exposed ports and service versions
steps: the box finds its public IP
Exposure shows open ports
each port shows the service and version
journeys.evidence: PARTLY on n74, 2026-11-17 (AI-Mlee as qa-walker, browser). The box found 222.254.212.114 itself (auto-detect hourly, ownership verified to 16 Dec 2026); Exposure lists 6 open ports from the 16 Nov deep scan. Service and version: only 10022 'OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu13.20'; 10443 nginx without version; 5060 sip and 2000 cisco-sccp without product; 11080 'unknown' and 11443 'ssl/unknown' name no service. sessions/customer-walk-n74.md M2-7, M2-8.

journeys.title: Update to a new release; back up and restore
steps: update from the previous signed release
take a backup
restore it on a clean box
